$comment: Suites that cannot pass without a host capability. 'profiles' holds the shared
explanation; 'entries' only name files and the profile they belong to.
kind=environment entries are re-checked on every run: when the probes succeed the
suite runs again with no edit, so a quarantine cannot hide a working test.
alwaysSkip marks a capability that cannot be probed cheaply; reviewBy is then the
kind=fixture entries are real red tests: they stay skipped until someone fixes the
cause, and reviewBy makes the entry fail the gate once it is overdue.

rpc-launch.reason: These suites execute the real RPC launch wrapper, which takes the run lock with flock and proves the launch process is its own group leader with 'ps -o pgid='. A host without the flock binary (stock macOS) or without permission to call ps cannot run them. Verified on 2026-10-19: with flock/ps shims on PATH these suites pass, and the only one that still needs a real flock is engine-rpc-run-guard.test.ts, because it tests lock contention and TERM/KILL takeover.

electron-sandbox.reason: The suite boots a real Electron BrowserWindow. Restricted runners reject it with 'sandbox initialization failed: Operation not permitted' before any assertion runs, so the failure says nothing about the editor code.

real-ssh-server.reason: The suite connects to a real OpenSSH server to exercise host-key trust. Without a reachable server it fails in under 200ms with RemoteSshConnectionError/network_unreachable, never reaching the assertion under test.

pty.reason: The suite allocates a real PTY through the terminal worker. Restricted runners reject it with 'failed to openpty: Operation not permitted' (EPERM) before the ssh argv and resize assertions run.
